methodologyNotes: Dataset covers 11 robotic/cordless pool cleaner models. NOTE: the requested roster mentioned an Aquabot Pool Rover, but no Aquabot model could be independently verified for a current US listing/config, so none is included (the original draft claimed to include it but never actually did). Primary sources are manufacturer product pages (maytronics.com, beatbot.com, aiper.com, bettabot.com, polarispool.com, pentair.com, wybotpool.com) and major US retailers (poolbots.com, eztestpools.com); secondary corroboration via Amazon listings, CPSC/CES press releases, and specialist review sites (PCWorld). priceUsd reflects published US MSRP or current manufacturer/retailer listed price as a number (no promotions or coupons applied); a boolean true/false indicates yes/no features; pool-size strings carry ft or sq ft units. All prices and headline specs re-verified on 2026-06-19 against manufacturer pages where available. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Maytronics Dolphin Nautilus CC Plus w/Wi-Fi
products.provenance: Price $849.00 confirmed on maytronics.com product page (re-verified 2026-06-19). Pool size (40 ft) and cycle time (2 hr) confirmed on same page. Release year 2020 from community references and Amazon ASIN date; exact Maytronics-published launch year not stated on page (kept as stated, not independently certain).

products.name: Aiper Seagull Pro
products.priceNote: Launch MSRP (March 2023); current street price significantly lower (~$530-$620)

specs.cycle_options: Floor Mode, Wall Mode, Auto Mode

products.provenance: Launch MSRP $899.99 and March 2023 availability confirmed in Aiper CES 2023 PR. Floor/walls/waterline coverage, WavePath navigation, 150-min runtime (7,800 mAh), quad-motor system, and 1,600 sq ft confirmed on aiper.com (re-verified 2026-06-19; manufacturer page states 1600 sq ft, though some retailers cite 3200 sq ft). RECALL: model ZT6001 was recalled (CPSC, March 2025) for adapter overheating/fire hazard; remedy is a free Aiper Scuba S1 replacement. (Removed draft's unverified 'current listing is ZT6002' claim.)

products.name: Betta SE Plus
products.priceNote: Regular MSRP per bettabot.com; on sale at $389.90

specs.suitable_pool_size_ft: up to 40 ft x 60 ft (2400 sq ft)

products.provenance: MSRP $499.90 and sale price $389.90 confirmed on bettabot.com (re-verified 2026-06-19). This is a SURFACE SKIMMER: bettabot.com states it cleans surface debris only and 'does not clean the pool bottom' -> cleaning_coverage CORRECTED from the draft's 'floor' to 'surface'. Ultrasonic radar navigation, 200 μm basket, 30+ hr runtime (solar + AC), and 2400 sq ft coverage confirmed. drive corrected to cordless_robotic to match its solar/battery cordless design.
